title: 第18章 艾米的情报第19章 法术之威
slug: 法师之上第366章五环法师
content_zh:
幽静的工作间内，烛火的光线忽明忽暗。
高德半晌未动，忽然间抬起右手，伸出食指，斜指前方。
光看这个动作，多少有些莫名其妙，神神叨叨。
但是，在高德做出这个动作之后，他的指尖处产生了神奇的能量波动，凭空射出一道蓝白色的光束。
这光束本体并不粗大，却带着一股莫名的寒意。
下一瞬，寒冷光束就像是一把飞刀一样嗖的一声从高德的指尖迸发而出，直直击打在前方高德放置的小灰鼠尸体之上。
当那道光束触及小灰鼠的那一刻，空气中能听见一声细微的冰裂之声。
小灰鼠的皮毛上瞬间凝结了一层薄冰。
薄冰的存在持续了大约二十秒后才散去。
“对死去的小灰鼠能持续二十秒，若是目标为塞达法师，能持续三秒就算不错的了。”
高德在心中暗暗计算道。
随即，他长吐了一口气。
“六天，三个戏法全部掌握！”
在彻底完善法术模型构建的新方法后，就一鼓作气将酸液飞溅的法术模型构建成功。
虽然主因是他使用的构建方法效率胜过传统方法太多，但多多少少还带着点运气成分。
或许修习法术也有所谓的新手福利吧。
总之，接下来“提升抗力”与“冰冻射线”这两个法术模型的构建，高德就没有延续第一天的好运气。
两个法术皆是在精神力损耗过度后仍未成功，需要等到次日精神力恢复之后，进行第二次乃至第三次尝试。
距离从约姆那购得三份法术配方已经过去六天。
就在刚刚，高德终于将冰冻射线的法术模型也构建成功。

这宣告着他已经将三个新法术全部掌握。
一等学徒，六天时间，掌握三个戏法。
说出去根本不可能有人会信！
这就是高德如今构建法术模型方法的优越之处。
只是高德也并没有自得的认为自己是个天才。
他清楚明白，之所以自己能实现这不可思议之变革，只不过是因为自己站在巨人的肩膀上罢了。
说到底其实也不过是拾前人牙慧。
对于这个世界的人来说：
先要改变固有观念，将边连接星轨边确定星子位置的传统构建方法，转换为先确定星子位置再连接星轨的新方法；
再利用解析几何建立坐标系的方法拆解法术模型来确定星子位置，既需要质疑权威的勇气，又需要解决新方法存在问题的知识。
更重要的是，还要有个“风灵月影”。
传统法术模型构建方法传承已经不知道多少年。
越强大的法师，按照传统方法根深蒂固的修习这么多年，在惯性思维之下，越难对其产生质疑与改变的想法。
而弱小的法师，更不会有这种痴心妄想了。
就像是日心说，放现在看来，不过是显而易见的道理，可在当年，地心说便是神圣不可侵犯的真理，绝不可质疑。
可对于异世来客的高德而言，他并不会有什么真理不真理的迂腐概念。
他还是一个新的不能再新的法师学徒，对法术的思维模式还未固定。
更何况，对于一个优秀的数学生来说，敢于质疑，敢于改变本就是基本素质之一。
老师用的方法不对，或者老师用的方法不好，那就用自己的方法解题，这是再正常不过的事情。
至于解析几何与笛卡尔坐标系，对这个世界的人来说，是全新领域的知识，是开创一个新的理念。

可对高德来说，这只不过是从自己的知识库中取出一个实用的方法罢了。
解析几何与笛卡尔坐标系在高德前世，并不算什么高深的知识，任何一个普通的初中生碰见这种情况，都能联想到。
但对这个世界的人来说，要想到坐标系，却是难如登天。
有些东西若是想到了，说穿了原理也很简单，但想到这一步却能卡住无数人。
想不到就是想不到。
content_en:
In the quiet workshop, the light of the candle flickers on and off.
Gothe didn't move for a long time, then suddenly raised his right hand, stretched out his index finger, and pointed diagonally forward.
Just looking at this action, it is somewhat inexplicable and confusing.
However, after Gothe made this action, magical energy fluctuations occurred at his fingertips, shooting a blue-white beam out of thin air.
The light beam itself is not thick, but it carries an inexplicable chill.
The next moment, the cold beam burst out from Gothe's fingertips like a flying knife, hitting the little squirrel corpse in front of Gothe.
The moment the beam of light touched the little squirrel, a subtle sound of ice cracking could be heard in the air.
A thin layer of ice instantly condensed on the little squirrel's fur.
The thin ice lasted for about twenty seconds before dissipating.
"It can last for twenty seconds on a dead little squirrel. If the target is Master Seda, it can last for three seconds, which is pretty good."
Gothe calculated secretly in his heart.
Then, he let out a long breath.
"Six days, master all three tricks!"
After thoroughly perfecting the new method of constructing a spell model, the acid splash spell model was successfully constructed in one go.
Although the main reason is that the construction method he used is much more efficient than the traditional method, it still involves a bit of luck.
Maybe practicing magic also has so-called novice benefits.
In short, in the subsequent construction of the two spell models of "increased resistance" and "freezing ray", Gaode did not continue the good luck from the first day.
Both spells were unsuccessful even after the mental power was excessively depleted. It was necessary to wait until the mental power was restored the next day before making a second or even third attempt.
Six days have passed since I purchased three spell formulas from Yom.
Just now, Gothe finally successfully constructed the spell model of freezing ray.
This announced that he had mastered all three new spells.
A first-class apprentice can master three tricks in six days.
It’s impossible for anyone to believe it!
This is the advantage of Gaode's current method of constructing spell models.
It's just that Gothe didn't proudly think that he was a genius.
He clearly understood that the reason why he was able to achieve this incredible change was simply because he stood on the shoulders of giants.
In the final analysis, it is just picking up the wisdom of the predecessors.
For people in this world:
First, the inherent concept must be changed, and the traditional construction method of determining the position of the planetesimals while connecting the star orbits to a new method of first determining the position of the planetesimals and then connecting the star orbits;
Then using analytical geometry to establish a coordinate system to dismantle the spell model to determine the position of the planets requires both the courage to question authority and the knowledge to solve problems with the new method.
More importantly, there must be a "Wind Spirit Moon Shadow".
The traditional spell model construction method has been passed down for who knows how many years.
The more powerful the mage is, the more ingrained he is in practicing according to traditional methods for so many years. Under the inertial thinking, it is more difficult for him to question and change his mind.
And a weak mage would not have such wishful thinking.
Just like the heliocentric theory, it seems obvious now, but at that time, the geocentric theory was a sacred and inviolable truth that could never be questioned.
But for Gao De, a visitor from another world, he does not have any pedantic concepts of truth and non-truth.
He is still a new mage apprentice, and his thinking mode about magic has not yet been fixed.
What's more, for an excellent mathematics student, daring to question and change is one of the basic qualities.
If the method used by the teacher is wrong, or the method used by the teacher is not good, then use your own method to solve the problem. This is a normal thing.
As for analytic geometry and the Cartesian coordinate system, for people in this world, it is a new field of knowledge and the creation of a new concept.
But for Gothe, this isIt's just a practical method taken from one's own knowledge base.
Analytical geometry and the Cartesian coordinate system were not considered advanced knowledge in Gothe's previous life. Any ordinary junior high school student could relate to this situation.
But for people in this world, thinking about the coordinate system is as difficult as climbing to the sky.
If you think of some things, the principle is very simple, but thinking of this step can block countless people.
Unexpected is unexpected.
